Leaf Blight.solution: Apply a copper-based fungicide and avoid overhead irrigation.

Powdery Mildew.solution: Use sulfur-based fungicides and ensure good air circulation.

Rust.solution: Apply fungicides with triazole or strobilurin, and remove infected leaves.

Downy Mildew.solution: Apply fungicides containing mancozeb or metalaxyl and reduce humidity.

Fusarium Wilt.solution: Use resistant varieties and improve soil drainage.

Anthracnose.solution: Remove infected plants and apply fungicides with chlorothalonil.

Bacterial Leaf Spot.solution: Use copper-based bactericides and remove infected plant parts.
symptoms: Dark brown spots with yellow margins

Septoria Leaf Spot.solution: Use fungicides containing chlorothalonil and remove affected leaves.

Leaf Curl.solution: Prune infected parts and apply insecticides to control aphids.

Late Blight.solution: Apply fungicides with mefenoxam and remove infected plants immediately.

Powdery Scab.solution: Improve soil drainage and apply fungicides with mancozeb.

Damping-Off.solution: Improve soil aeration, reduce watering, and use fungicides like thiabendazole.

Botrytis Blight.solution: Remove infected parts and apply fungicides with pyraclostrobin.

Chlorosis.solution: Correct soil pH and add iron or magnesium supplements.

Cercospora Leaf Spot.solution: Apply fungicides containing mancozeb or copper.

Wilt Disease.solution: Improve irrigation systems and use fungicides with benomyl.

White Mold.solution: Remove infected plants and apply fungicides containing tebuconazole.

Crown Rot.solution: Improve soil drainage and apply fungicides like fludioxonil.
symptoms: Dark, sunken lesions at the base

Tomato Spotted Wilt Virus.solution: Remove infected plants and control thrips using insecticides.

Peach Leaf Curl.solution: Apply copper fungicides and prune infected parts.

Frost Damage.solution: Protect plants with row covers and use antifreeze sprays.

Mosaic Virus.solution: Remove infected plants and control insect vectors.

Gummy Stem Blight.solution: Apply fungicides like tebuconazole and prune infected stems.
symptoms: Brown spots on stems and leaves

Grey Mold.solution: Apply fungicides with boscalid or fludioxonil and improve ventilation.

Sclerotinia Rot.solution: Remove infected plants and apply fungicides containing pyraclostrobin.
symptoms: Cottony fungal growth on plant tissues

Bacterial Wilt.solution: Remove infected plants and improve soil drainage.

Apple Scab.solution: Apply fungicides with myclobutanil and remove infected leaves.

Citrus Canker.solution: Apply copper-based fungicides and prune affected branches.

Black Rot.solution: Remove affected parts and apply fungicides with chlorothalonil.

Southern Blight.solution: Use soil fumigants and remove infected plant debris.
symptoms: White fungal growth at soil line

Fusarium Head Blight.solution: Apply fungicides containing tebuconazole and use resistant varieties.

Cabbage Root Maggot.solution: Use insecticides with imidacloprid and practice crop rotation.

Thrips Damage.solution: Apply insecticides containing spinosad and use yellow sticky traps.

Leaf Miners.solution: Use insecticides with neem oil and remove infested leaves.

Spider Mites.solution: Use miticides and increase humidity to discourage their spread.
